profile.headline: Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary: Software Engineer with a strong emphasis on application architecture and robust software design for high scale projects. Strong experience developing for both iPhone and iPad. I dig analytic driven development and Agile methodologies. My specialties include: Java, iOS, Objective-C, Perl, Android, and geolocation based projects.

positions.title: Senior iOS Software Engineer
positions.description:
Piictu is a visual network that allows people to collaborate around ideas, interests and experiences through the use of pictures from their mobile phone.

- Lead Development of Lenz ~ Photo Guide.
- Lead Development of v1.4 including support for iPhone 5.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
HopStop provides door-to-door public transit directions and maps in 100's of cities throughout the US, Canada & Europe.

- Lead major overhaul of iPhone app.
- Lead HopStop for iPad. ( http://thenextweb.com/apps/2012/01/23/hopstop-rockets-past-1m-downloads-and-launches-a-brand-new-ipad-app/ )
- Prototyped API with Perl, Dancer and MongoDB.
- Deployed and managed self-hosted JIRA.
- ￼Managed and maintained Linux web servers in Amazon’s cloud.

positions.title: Application Development and IT Operations Engineer
positions.description:
- Ported CGI web applications to FastCGI improving server performance by 2000%.
- Started iPad app Development.
- Backend work for new site redesign.
- ￼Created scripts and deployed servers that eased and hastened development team’s effort.

positions.title: Android Software Engineer
positions.description:
Based in Krakow, Poland, Binarytech Solutions focuses on Mobile, Web and Custom IT Solutions for companies around the globe. The main focus is mobile development geared towards iOS and Android. Clients include Warner Brothers, Bank of America and SeaWorld.

I worked on several projects including location aware applications for Android.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Developed a payment system for utilities bills in C++ and MySQL.
